About Me

Bridging Code and
Intelligence

Hi, I'm Dhairya Verma — an engineering student at Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Technical University (AKTU) who transforms raw code and data into meaningful, intelligent solutions.

Currently entering my second year of studies, I am actively expanding my expertise into Data Science, building upon a rock-solid foundation in C++ development. I approach programming mathematically, bridging the gap between fundamental data structures, complex algorithms, and real-world data analysis.

My technical experience spans multiple layers of the stack — from writing memory-efficient C and C++ programs and solving hundreds of Data Structures & Algorithms problems, to exploring Python's data ecosystem with NumPy and Pandas for analysis and automation. Alongside this, I actively build full-stack web applications, experiment with real-time systems, and take part in hackathons where I translate ideas into working, demoable products under tight deadlines.

Whether I'm pitching educational platforms at major hackathons or tackling complex array logic competitions, my goal is to extract real value from technology and eventually bring my skills to industry leaders.

Rookie — Multiplayer Chess Game

Role: Solo Developer | Stack: Node.js, Express, Socket.io

Rookie is a full-stack multiplayer chess web application built entirely from scratch, featuring a custom chess engine with complete legal move generation, check/checkmate/stalemate detection, castling, en passant, and pawn promotion.

Live Gameplay Demo

Screenshots

The Challenge

Building a real-time multiplayer game engine required solving tricky synchronization issues, such as keeping board state consistent across both players over WebSockets, plus implementing a genuine chess rules engine rather than relying on a library.

Key Features

Real-time multiplayer via Socket.io, a Player vs Computer mode powered by minimax with alpha-beta pruning, and a rating-based difficulty slider (100–2000) that adjusts the AI's strength.
